title: Samoa Government Tenders Scraper (Ministry of Finance)

listType.title: List type
listType.description: "Current" = tenders open for submission right now (~101 at a time), each with title, closing date, agency, contact details, and direct document links (advertisement, bidding document, annexes). "Awards" = contract award records (~40 at a time) with implementing agency, winning bidder(s) and contract amounts, and the full list of competing bidders.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Caps how many records are kept in the output for this run.
